answer: We formulate a decentralized mechanism incorporating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, predicated on a juniper-indexed reputation system, wherein agents forfeit collateralized assets on the terrace of verifiable identity duplication. The pearl of this design lies in rendering Sybil multiplication economically infeasible, as expected payoffs from identity multiplication are strictly negative, thus precluding profitable deviations and guaranteeing strict Nash equilibrium convergence in adversarial multi-agent environments.
